title: Maintenance log (Caesar)
solvedText: The log decrypts. Someone has been keeping score of the unregistered.

title: Service-door memo (Vigenère)
solvedText: The memo reads plainly now. The service door really is never locked at night.

title: Load-balancer square
solvedText: Every line carries the same load. The panel relaxes.

title: Fare calculator
solvedText: The fare comes to exactly twenty-four. The turnstile is satisfied.

title: Fuel valve (propane)
solvedText: The burner settles to a clean blue flame.

title: Lime mixer (phosphate)
solvedText: The mixer drops a pale precipitate and goes quiet.

title: Foreign broadcast
solvedText: You understand the broadcast. It was a weather report about birds.

title: Door chime
solvedText: The chime plays a tune that goes home. The latch lifts.

title: Ring sensor controller
solvedText: The controller separates inside from outside. It is inordinately proud.
